description: Mercado Bitcoin (public market data) (trading): list_markets, get_ticker, get_candles. Every tool ma

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: GET /symbols returns every instrument as parallel arrays; the server filters them by `query` (substring of symbol, base or quote, case-insensitive; the API itself filters only by exact symbols), sorts them by symbol and pages them locally (page/limit).

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: symbol is BASE-QUOTE, e.g. BTC-BRL. Prices are in the quote currency; volume is 24h base volume. An unknown symbol answers an empty list (invalid_input).

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: interval is one of 1m, 15m, 1h, 3h, 1d, 1w, 1M; the latest `limit` bars up to now (countback). time is the bar's Unix timestamp (seconds, UTC).
